gatherer.name: The Gatherer
gatherer.gift: You bring warmth to good company.
gatherer.tagline: Rooted in hospitality, generous tables, and shared stories.
gatherer.description: You understand that good things are made to be shared. You bring people together and turn solitary efforts into vibrant communities.
gatherer.lifePrompt: Invite two people who should know each other to share a meal.
gatherer.fieldPrompt: Pull up a chair to our table notes and family recipes.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.gift: You bring possibility to good company.
explorer.tagline: Drawn to untraveled roads and open possibilities.
explorer.description: You thrive where plans give way to curiosity. In every project, you provide the momentum and the instinct to see what lies beyond the next turn.
explorer.lifePrompt: Take the unfamiliar route and document one thing you nearly missed.
explorer.fieldPrompt: Seek out uncharted notes and open-ended experiments.

craftsman.name: The Craftsman
craftsman.gift: You bring shape to good ideas.
craftsman.tagline: Driven by care, fine lines, and the patience of the workshop.
craftsman.description: You know that beauty lives in the details. You take raw ideas and shape them into lasting, purposeful work.
craftsman.lifePrompt: Make the smallest real version of an idea you keep postponing.
craftsman.fieldPrompt: Inspect our workbench dispatches and making-of notes.

catalyst.name: The Catalyst
catalyst.gift: You bring momentum to good ideas.
catalyst.tagline: Sparking action, cross-pollinating ideas, and defying inertia.
catalyst.description: You connect disparate dots and ignite momentum. You refuse to let worthwhile adventures gather dust on a shelf.
catalyst.lifePrompt: Send the message that could start something worthwhile.
catalyst.fieldPrompt: Explore active collaborations and in-progress ventures.

storykeeper.name: The Storykeeper
storykeeper.gift: You bring meaning to good company.
storykeeper.tagline: Recording, remembering, and passing on good ideas.
storykeeper.description: You find the meaning hiding in ordinary moments. You help people remember what matters and why it mattered.
storykeeper.lifePrompt: Ask someone you love for a story you have never heard.
storykeeper.fieldPrompt: Explore our chronicles and recorded stories.

questions.prompt: A free Saturday appears. Where do you go?

options.text: Down a road I have never taken
Toward a long table and a full kitchen
The market to catch up on the latest news
Into the workshop with an unfinished idea
Into the city to meet friends and start a project

questions.prompt: The mark of a truly great project is:

options.text: The quiet precision and durability of its craft
The new collaborations and energy it sparked
The feeling of welcome and warmth it creates for others
The tales we will find through the process
The unexpected territory it opened up along the way

questions.prompt: When staring at a blank notebook, your instinct is to:

options.text: Draft a manifesto and send a note to a partner
Write the opening scene and what follows
Draw precise diagrams and working mechanisms
Map out an itinerary or list of wild questions
Sketch a recipe or an outline for a gathering

questions.prompt: In good company, you are most often the one who:

options.text: Regales the company with a good yarn
Asks 'what if we went somewhere else right now?'
Refills glasses and makes sure everyone has a seat
Connects two people who need to know each other
Listens intently and ponders how the problem was solved

questions.prompt: Choose a motto to hang above your workbench:

options.text: Never leave a good question unexplored.
Every tale is worth remembering—and passing down.
Care over polish. Build things that last.
Pull up a chair; there is always room for one more.
Small spark, steady fire, worthwhile adventure.
